description: This file contains the PHP class `Marketplace` which extends the system engine controller and manages marketplace extensions within the OpenCart admin interface. It provides methods for listing, installing, and uninstalling marketplace extensions, and generates associated views and API responses.

classes.name: Marketplace
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketplace extensions in the OpenCart admin panel, including listing, installing, and uninstalling extensions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Default method that sets the output response to the list of marketplace extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves available marketplace extensions, installed extensions, and renders the marketplace view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of a marketplace extension via API request, including permission checks and dynamic controller setup.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process of a marketplace extension via API request, including permission checks and dynamic controller invocation.
